BUILDER.purpose: Implement bounded code changes through branch, tests, PR and proof.

REVIEWER.purpose: Independent code/proof review without modifying source.

FALSIFIER.purpose: Adversarially search for defects, unsupported claims and failure cases.

GEMINI_CHALLENGER.purpose: Use a Gemini model selected in Copilot when available to challenge Federation architecture/code; observed model identity must be read back before scoring.

credit_policy.truth_boundary: A repository task cap is a planning control, not proof that GitHub will terminate a running agent at that amount. Paid-overage claims require provider-side budget and usage readback.

cfbe_binding.rule: Do not invent quality/value from token counts. Only independently observed normalized metrics may enter CFBE route scoring.

truth_boundary: This source admission does not prove Copilot cloud-agent execution, a particular model invocation, AI-credit consumption, code-review behavior, MCP connectivity, provider budget enforcement, or value improvement. Those require separate runtime and billing/usage readback.
